name: Netflix Rewatch
author: Thunderhat
description: Netflix-style rewatch behaviour for Plex TV shows. When you finish rewatching an already-watched episode, later episodes are marked unwatched so Plex Continue Watching advances naturally.

settingsSchema.label: TV libraries
settingsSchema.help: No libraries are selected by default. Choose which TV libraries may be modified.

settingsSchema.label: Watched threshold (%)
settingsSchema.help: Only trigger after playback reaches this percentage of the episode.

settingsSchema.label: Include specials
settingsSchema.help: When off, season 0 episodes are ignored for rewind planning.

settingsSchema.label: Dry run
settingsSchema.help: Record what would change without calling Plex scrobble/unscrobble.

settingsSchema.label: Include shows only
settingsSchema.help: If non-empty, only these show titles are eligible (one per line).

settingsSchema.label: Excluded shows
settingsSchema.help: Show titles that should never be rewritten (one per line).
